newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply additional emergency funds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply additional emergency funds.

text.p: The Bank of Korea plans to inject an additional 500 billion won to the banking system on Friday through repurchase agreements, its second emergency fund supply of the day, an official at the bank said.
Earlier on Friday the central bank effectively supplied another 489 billion won to banks by allowing them to cash in repurchase agreements in that amount ahead of maturity.
The Bank of Korea is supplying an enormous amount of money to ease a tightening of liquidity amid jitters over the Kia Group's financial crisis.
Kia Motors Corp and 17 other units of the group have been offered protection by creditor banks.
The decision to bail out the group, announced on Tuesday, has led to a surge in bond yields and a decline of the won against the U.S. dollar.
